config.notes: Course pages www.federation.edu.au/courses/<code>-<slug>. Server renders the DOMESTIC view by default; only international-only (Melbourne city campus) courses are stored in the international view. Top panel: Fees label, Credit, Study mode, Duration, Start dates (dated list e.g. 01 March 2027 26 July 2027 22 November 2027), Locations. Fee read only from "International full fee-paying place 2026 indicative full-time fee: $X" (annual, 1 EFTSL; for 0.5 EFTSL certificates the whole-certificate fee is shown - exclude). Domestic fees never read. English: "English language requirements Overall IELTS band score of X, with no band less than Y". Start dates on domestic-view pages are domestic intakes and may include online/domestic-only terms (Late Summer Jan, Winter Apr, Spring Sep, Oct). Central: international intakes https://www.federation.edu.au/apply/how-to-apply/international/standard-cut-off-dates/ (Semester 1 = March, Semester 2 = July, Summer = November; Early Semester 1/2 Nursing = January/June). English policy https://www.federation.edu.au/apply/how-to-apply/international/english-language-requirements/ . Fee schedule PDF https://www.federation.edu.au/siteassets/files/students/fees/2027_higher_ed_commencing_international_student_tuition_fee_schedule.pdf Delivery (5 Oct, Platform Admin 11:48): the international view stored for the international-only courses shows Course essentials (IELTS, Fees International Fee Paying Place, Credit) and prints NO Study mode; the mode pattern reads the Study mode panel of the DOMESTIC view (e.g. "On campus Online", where online is only for those not on an international student visa), so it is not the international delivery and must not be admitted as delivery until international-view pages are captured.
